reviews.review:
This game is truly amazing. They took the Mars Attacks IP and decided to do something unique with it, a park management, and it works so. so. well. The first time I was told about this product I did not believe they were serious, and I was a bit concerned about their mental well-being.

This concern did not really go away seeing what they came up with artistically in this game, but my doubts were shattered. Outlier found a balance between a "serious" park management and diving deep into the humor which makes the franchise work, and it helps making this game work. You unlock more and more stuff out off the humans you experiment on, so unlocking a ferries wheel is such an awesome experience when you realize which body parts are now in there :D

I have followed this game through its development, I have followed the previous game equally closely. I am confident they will once again take this Early Access trust and use it to improve even more onto this game, and the final product will be even more polished and fun than this one already is.

So yes, if you have a bit to spare, do buy this game and give it a try. No matter if you like park management or not, it will still be a fun ride :D
